headlines.text: Rewind to 2022, when Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. Proud-N-Powerful & Kingston vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. 2.O vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Eddie Kingston vs. Angelo Parker vs. Matt Menard vs. Chris Jericho vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jake Hager vs. Sammy Guevara settled things in a Blood And Guts match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.42 ? a real highlight of the night ? part of that year's Blood and Guts '22. Broken glass, barbed wire and a re-opened head wound from Forbidden Door all made appearances as Blackpool Combat Club and allies outlasted the Jericho Appreciation Society inside the double cage.

On a Saturday in 2019, back when Jon Moxley vs. Joey Janela settled things in a Lights Out match, closing out the card as the main event on Fyter Fest, rated 7.98 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? part of that year's Fyter Fest '19. Moxley's in-ring AEW debut, an unsanctioned brawl through tables and thumbtacks that instantly washed away memories of his old WWE character ? the show closed with Kenny Omega ambushing Moxley afterward, smashing him with a Stratocaster and adding real spice to their feud.
Flash back to 2024, when Stephanie Vaquer made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Lady Frost, appearing on Collision, rated 6.24.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2024, when Robbie Eagles made their AEW debut, appearing on Collision, rated 6.08.
That Saturday in 2019, The Elite vs. Lucha Brothers & Laredo Kid met for the very first time on Fyter Fest, rated 8.17 ? one of the better matches of the year.
On this day in 2022, Danhausen stepped through the curtain for the first time against FTR & Gunn Club & Caster, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.44.
